title: Cognitive performance and quality of life after neurosurgical operations for benign brain tumors in advanced age
summary: The aim of this study is to investigate the cognitive performance and quality of life of patients aged 65 and older after the surgical removal of benign brain tumours (e.g., meningiomas, pituitary adenomas). Standardised instruments will be used preoperatively, as well as 1 week, 3 months, and 15 months postoperatively. The results are intended to contribute to improving decision-making and patient counselling.
conditions: Benign neoplasm of brain and other parts of central nervous system

interventions.name: The study investigates the cognitive performance and quality of life in patients aged 65 and older following the surgical removal of benign brain tumours (e.g., meningiomas, pituitary adenomas). Standardised instruments such as the Montreal Cognitive Assessment (MoCA), the SF-36 RAND Version 1.0,  W

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
• Age ≥ 65 years
• Diagnosed benign brain tumor (e.g., meningiomas, pituitary adenomas)
• Ability to provide consent and complete the tests
Exclusion criteria:
• Malignant brain tumors or metastases
• Severe psychiatric disorders or preoperative dementia (MMSE <20)
• Surgical contraindications
